steps.name: Step 1 — Create a pipeline with a Code node — verify it renders on the canvas
Step 2 — Code node script uses elitea_client.get_user_data() then a bare 'user_info' name reference as the final statement
Step 3 — Code node Output is set to user_info with structured output enabled
Step 4 — Execute the pipeline via the embedded chat
Step 5 — Verify Code node executes without errors in Run Details

Step 6 — Verify Code node output state variable contains the user information (email + name present -- structure, not literal values, since the test-bot's own account fields could legitimately change)
Axis 2 — Verify no unexpected console errors (excluding the known #1267 signature)
